purpose: Teach: 実地/旅費/引数/業態/格付け/送迎/旅客/打ち込ん

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 今期、本気で、絶対、実地視察、絶対、各支店、絶対、進めましょう
lines.en: This quarter, we should really commit to conducting on-site inspections at every branch.
lines.style: Crisp, authoritative opening. Forward momentum. Measured pace with slight weight on 'commit' and 'every branch.' Professional, not harsh.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。出張の旅費、本気で、絶対、見直しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively reviewing travel budgets for business trips. Thank you for your understanding.
lines.style: Respectful agreement. Steady, earnest tone. Slight pause before 'reviewing' to show careful attention. Genuine gratitude at the close.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プログラムの引数、本気で、絶対、エンジニア、絶対、確認してね
lines.en: And our engineers need to verify the program parameters carefully.
lines.style: Directive but not curt. Light emphasis on 'verify' and 'carefully.' Expectant pause after — waiting for confirmation of understanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規業態、本気で、絶対、調査、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively conducting market research on new business models. Thank you for the guidance.
lines.style: Assuring, present. Slightly faster pace showing diligence in action. Genuine warmth on 'thank you,' not perfunctory.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社の格付け、本気で、絶対、業界で、絶対、上位、絶対、目指したいわね
lines.en: I'd really like us to aim for a top industry ranking for our company's rating.
lines.style: Aspirational but grounded. Slight lift on 'top,' then settle into resolve. Personal stake implied — not just a directive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、送迎サービス、絶対、好評です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The staff feedback on our new shuttle service has been really positive. Thank you for that initiative.
lines.style: Warm, pleased. Genuine smile in the voice. Slightly relaxed pace. Pride in reporting good news.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 旅客対応、本気で、絶対、社員、絶対、教育、絶対、徹底しましょう
lines.en: We need to strengthen our training on passenger relations — make it consistent across the team.
lines.style: Firm but constructive. Even pacing. Weight on 'strengthen' and 'consistent.' The tone of someone who cares about quality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、新事業に、絶対、打ち込んでくれています、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our staff are throwing themselves into the new business. I'm grateful for their commitment.
lines.style: Warm closing note. Genuine appreciation, not obligatory. Slightly slower, more thoughtful. A real moment of connection.
